verdict.rationale: Supabase documents first-party event-driven automation. Database Webhooks fire HTTP requests to any endpoint, including Edge Functions, on table INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE events, built as a wrapper around Postgres triggers via pg_net. Supabase Cron runs SQL, database functions or HTTP calls on time-based schedules from every second to once a year, created via SQL or the Dashboard, and Queues adds durable background task delivery. Missing for 10: conditional rule logic or filtering beyond raw table events, triggers on non-table events (auth, storage), documented retry and delivery guarantees for webhooks, and an explicitly documented agent path for defining these rules, plus independent hands-on corroboration.
